services.name: Summer Camps
services.desc: Join us for Summer Camps at the Chan Centre for the Performing Arts at UBC, where children explore music through digital media and STEM-inspired activities. Our camps are designed for children ages 5-12 who are curious about music and digital media. No prior experience or skills are required. Some camps may have age-appropriate prerequisites; please refer to individual camp pages for details. Returning campers are welcome! This year’s camps feature new themes, activities, and experiences.
